data.title: FM Sihasak tells envoy to ensure Israeli visitors respect Thai culture
data.description: Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow has asked Israeli ambassador Alona Fisher-Kamm to be more serious about instructing Israeli tourists to respect Thai culture and traditions, to protect bilateral ties.

data.title: No-smoking warning near oil leak on Bangkok’s Rama III Road
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration has warned people not to smoke near drains along a section of Rama III Road because it could ignite an oil leak and cause an explosion.

data.title: Approved state welfare applicants warned to verify ID
data.description: More than 500,000 newly approved state welfare applicants have yet to verify their identities, putting their eligibility to receive benefits from Oct 1 at risk if they do not complete their so-called e-KYC by Sept 30.

data.title: More delays on Airport Rail Link, commuters bused to airport
data.description: Trains on the Bangkok-Suvarnabhumi airport service suffered delays for the second day running on Tuesday, forcing the operator to bus commuters between the city centre and two destinations, including the airport.

data.title: Insurance plan to cover 30 million households
data.description: The Thai government plans to launch a national disaster insurance scheme in October covering 30 million households against floods, windstorms and earthquakes, with the state budgeting about 15.5 billion baht a year for premiums.

data.title: PM Anutin maps path to resilience
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Monday emphasised the importance of strengthening the country's resilience from within to ensure steady advancement amid rapidly changing geopolitical and technological contexts.

data.title: Scam gang nets B800k from student
data.description: A 19-year-old university student was stopped from sending more money to a call-centre gang that had already taken more than 800,000 baht from her parents, the Anti-Online Scam Center (ACSC) said.

data.title: Opposition wants budget cut further
data.description: Opposition MPs on Monday pressed the government to slash the 2027 budget by far more than the 11.16 billion baht already trimmed by a special committee, as the House of Representatives opened the bill's second reading.

data.title: Sondhi returns to street demos
data.description: Veteran activist and media mogul Sondhi Limthongkul on Monday unveiled a new political campaign under the banner "Take Our Thailand Back" to monitor the government's performance.

data.title: Israel moves to address  tourist issues
data.description: Israel is working with Thailand to address misconduct by Israeli tourists while seeking to prevent individual incidents from straining bilateral relations, Israeli Ambassador Alona Fisher-Kamm said.

data.title: MP asks for more time to speak to DSI
data.description: People's Party Phuket MP Somchart Techathavorncharoen has asked the Department of Special Investigation (DSI) to postpone giving evidence in an alleged foreign-nominee inquiry until the end of this month.

data.title: New road to improve traffic in city's east
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) on Monday signed a 1.33-billion-baht contract with Prayoonchai (1984) Co Ltd for the first phase of a road linking Rattanakosin Somphot and Nimit Mai roads in eastern Bangkok.

data.title: Israel keen to step up cybersecurity ties with Thailand
data.description: Israel and Thailand should strengthen cybersecurity cooperation, Israeli officials and experts said at a Bangkok workshop yesterday on cyber threats, artificial intelligence and human capital.

data.title: PM appoints 3 data centre experts
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has appointed three experts to the Data Center Business Policy Committee, taking its membership to 21, a Government House source said.

data.title: Family seeks justice  after car crash
data.description: The family of elderly crash victims has sought help from Sai Mai Tong Rot ("Sai Mai Must Survive") after a former school director allegedly hit their pickup twice while drunk and tried to flee.

data.title: Mayor says US Navy leisure visit created 'new Pattaya image'
data.description: The five-day leisure visit by US sailors from the aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln group has helped promote a “new image” of Pattaya as a diverse tourist destination, rather than mainly about "nightlife and beer bars", according to Pattaya Mayor Poramet Ngampichet.

data.title: 109 illegal rosewood logs seized in Chiang Rai
data.description: A total of 109 large logs of illegally harvested rosewood were seized after authorities tracked and stopped two trucks in the northern border province of Chiang Rai on Sunday night.

data.title: Bodies will be removed from unlicensed jewish cemetery, says minister
data.description: At least three bodies will be exhumed and removed from an unlicensed jewish cemetery in Chachoengsao province, and authorities will check the legality of other judaic cemeteries, Deputy Interior Minister Polapee Suwunchwee said on Monday.

data.title: S.Korea lifts travel alert for Thailand
data.description: South Korea has lifted a travel alert advising its citizens avoid travel to the Thai border with Cambodia.

data.title: Veteran protester Sondhi targets govt and troublesome Israelis
data.description: Veteran protest organiser Sondhi Limthongkul on Monday announced a nationwide campaign to monitor the government's performance, and demanded the deportation of troublesome Israeli visitors.

data.title: Frenchman being deported for causing religious division
data.description: A Frenchman staying on Koh Samui has been ordered to leave Thailand amid accusations his actions stirred religious division and conflict among foreign tourists.

data.title: Video of solitary spectator brings crowd back to struggling zoo in Samut Prakan
data.description: A video of an elephant show going ahead as scheduled in an empty arena with only a single spectator at a crocodile farm and zoo in Samut Prakan province has brought a massive wave of visitors, helping revive the fortunes of the 70-year-old attraction.

data.title: Airport Rail Link delays part of an 'upgrade'
data.description: Trains on the Bangkok-Suvarnabhumi airport service were running every 15 minutes on Monday, instead of the usual nine minutes, drawing complaints from commuters over the lack of a clear explanation for the change..

data.title: Fire damages snack factory in Samut Sakhon
data.description: SAMUT SAKHON - A fire damaged the snack and beverage plant of Srinanaporn Marketing Plc in Krathum Baen district on Monday morning.

data.title: Thai Airways cancels flights to Jakarta, volcanic eruption closes airports
data.description: Thai Airways International cancelled flights to Jakarta on Monday as eight Indonesian airports, including two serving the Indonesian capital, remained closed because of ash from erupting Krakatau volcano.
